description_en: Queries all attribute information of an instance, such as the instance ID and instance description

kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost describe-instance-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1ghxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
